description: The directive placed at the top of a file that marks the transition from the server-only module graph to the client JavaScript bundle, pulling all of its transitive imports into the browser bundle.
The wire protocol Next.js uses to stream rendered Server Component trees and serialize props passed across a 'use client' boundary, prohibiting plain functions and class instances.
Passing a Server Component as children or a ReactNode prop into a Client Component so the client wrapper can manage interactive state around pre-rendered server markup without importing it.
An explicit, stripped-down object created on the server before passing data to a Client Component so internal fields like supplier costs or tokens are never serialized into the browser payload.
A build-time guard module that triggers a compilation error if any Client Component directly or transitively imports a server-restricted file.
